name: caracolandia
description: Aplicación web de apuestas simuladas en carreras de caracoles (React + Express + TypeScript).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
